column1: # Qualification stage of the local-context gate: the six declared candidate local blocks
# against the composition control and against composition plus the mutation-local profile
# block, on the frozen 201-assay Readout anchor, at the three prespecified split seeds.
# Every design in this stage is built from sequence and alignment statistics alone, so no
# model quantity reaches any fitted number and no candidate can be tuned against the
# increment it is later meant to absorb. The anchor arm supplies the support and the labels;
# its own likelihood and representation are loaded by the shared panel loader and discarded.
# Slot 2 applies the declared gate across the three seeds and names what is carried forward.
